## Every other platform hands you software.   
Financiario hands you the answers.
Accounting tells you what happened. FP&A tools give you another system to run.   
Fractional CFOs give you someone to depend on.   
  
Financiario gives you answers, engineered, connected, and live from day one.
**No CFO****Have A CFO**
No CFO? No problem. Financiario delivers the financial intelligence your business needs — connected 3-statement model, 60-month cash flow forecasts, capital planning, and board-ready reporting — automatically updated, without anyone touching the numbers. You underwrite the assumptions. Financiario handles everything that follows.
Already have a CFO? Financiario eliminates the manual work and gives them the infrastructure to focus on what matters — cash flow engineering, growth decisions, and the strategic questions that move the business forward.

## AI is only as good as the model beneath it
Point an AI at raw accounting data and you get output you can't trust, can't replicate, and can't take to a bank. Financiario gives your AI the one thing it is missing: a CFO-engineered, connected 3-statement model as its foundation.  
‍
Every number is computed through that model, deterministic and auditable, never guessed. The AI answers from your numbers, not from patterns. What comes out is decision-grade, grounded in your company, explainable to your board, and consistent for your CEO, your finance team, your lender, and your investors.   
‍
